blocks.title: Reaction mechanism
blocks.text: Reaction mechanism is baat ki qadam ba qadam tafseel hai ke chemical reaction molecules ki satah par kaise ho kar product(s) banati hai.

Balanced equation sirf reactants aur products dikhati hai, lekin mechanism woh asal alag alag qadam dikhata hai jin se products bante hain; inhen elementary steps kehte hain. Har qadam ek molecular waqia hai, jaise kisi bond ka tootna ya banna.
Bohat si reactions ek qadam mein nahi balke kai qadmon mein hoti hain. Har qadam ko elementary reaction kehte hain, aur yeh seedha atoms, ions ya molecules ke takrane se hota hai.

blocks.title: Molecularity
blocks.text: Kisi elementary step mein hissa lene wale reactant molecules ki tadaad us step ki molecularity kehlati hai.

blocks.title: Unimolecular
blocks.text: Unimolecular elementary reaction mein sirf ek reactant molecule hota hai.

blocks.title: Bimolecular
blocks.text: Jis elementary reaction mein do atoms, ions ya molecules hissa lein use bimolecular kehte hain.
Misalein:

blocks.latex: \begin{aligned} &\ce{CO_{(g)} + NO3_{(g)} -> NO2_{(g)} + CO2_{(g)}} \\ &\ce{NO_{(g)} + O3_{(g)} -> NO2_{(g)} + O2_{(g)}} \end{aligned}
blocks.text_alt: CO(g) + NO₃(g) → NO₂(g) + CO₂(g);  NO(g) + O₃(g) → NO₂(g) + O₂(g)

blocks.title: Termolecular
blocks.text: Termolecular step mein teen molecules ek saath react karte hain.
Aisi reactions kam hoti hain (teen cheezon ka ek hi lamhe takrana mushkil hai). Misal: stratosphere mein ya smog bante waqt oxygen molecules aur oxygen atom se ozone banna.

blocks.title: Intermediates
blocks.text: Intermediates kam der rehne wale zarre (ions ya free radicals) hain jo mechanism ke ek qadam mein bante hain aur agle kisi qadam mein kharch ho jate hain.
Yeh kul (overall) balanced equation mein nazar nahi aate kyun ke yeh mustaqil (stable) products nahi hain.
Rate determining step

blocks.title: Rate-determining step
blocks.text: Bohat se mechanisms mein ek qadam baqi sab se kahin zyada sust hota hai; use rate-determining step kehte hain.

Yahi qadam poori reaction ki rate control karta hai, kyun ke reaction is se tez nahi chal sakti. Kul balanced equation sab qadmon ka majmooi nateeja hai. Rate-determining step ke baad wale qadam rate par asar nahi karte, is liye un mein aane wale atoms, ions ya molecules rate expression mein nahi aate. Jo reactants rate-determining step mein hain, woh rate equation mein bhi aate hain. Isi liye reaction ka order rate-determining step se nikala ja sakta hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Socho ek line mein log ek tang darwaze se guzar rahe hain. Baqi rasta kitna bhi chaura ho, log utni hi tezi se nikal sakte hain jitna woh tang darwaza ijazat de. Sab se sust qadam yahi tang darwaza hai.
Yeh reaction dekhein:

Table 7.3 mein chhe experiments ke nataij hain. Pehle teen mein NO ki concentration wahi rakh kar H₂ barhaya gaya: H₂ dugna karne par rate dugni aur tigna karne par tigni hui. Yani rate H₂ ki concentration ki pehli power ke proportional hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan 'Table 7.2' likhti hai; yeh experiments asal mein Table 7.3 mein hain (Table 7.2 hydrogen peroxide wali hai).

blocks.caption: Table 7.3: 2NO + 2H₂ ki initial rate par concentration ka asar (sahi qeematein)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Table 7.3 mein units adhoori chhapi hain ('mol dm⁻', 'atm min⁻'; sahi mol dm⁻³ aur atm min⁻¹), pehli row mein faltu chhote hindse hain (0.006³, 0.001³, 0.025¹; sahi 0.006, 0.001, 0.025), aur teesri row ki rate 0.0075 chhapi hai jabke [H₂] tigna karne par rate tigni yani 0.075 honi chahiye.
Agle teen experiments mein H₂ wahi rakha gaya. NO dugna karne par rate chaar guna aur tigna karne par nau guna hui. Yani rate NO ki concentration ke square (power 2) ke proportional hai.
Kul rate equation:

Is liye yeh third order reaction hai (1 + 2 = 3). Yahi is reaction ka rate law hai. Yaad rakhein: rate law balanced equation se andaza nahi lagaya ja sakta. Is reaction ka mumkin do qadmi mechanism yeh hai:

blocks.latex: \begin{aligned} &\text{Step 1: } \ce{2NO_{(g)} + H2_{(g)} ->[Slow] N2_{(g)} + H2O2_{(g)}}\quad \text{(rate determining step)} \\ &\text{Step 2: } \ce{H2O2_{(g)} + H2_{(g)} ->[Fast] 2H2O_{(g)}} \end{aligned}
blocks.text_alt: Step 1: 2NO(g) + H₂(g) →(slow) N₂(g) + H₂O₂(g) (rate determining step);  Step 2: H₂O₂(g) + H₂(g) →(fast) 2H₂O(g)

blocks.text: Step 1 sust hai aur rate tai karta hai. Is mein 2 NO aur 1 H₂ hain, isi liye rate = k[H₂][NO]².
Doosri misal nitrogen dioxide aur fluorine gas ka reaction hai:
Yeh reaction NO₂ ke lihaz se first order, F₂ ke lihaz se first order aur kul second order hai. Tajurbe se mila rate law:
Is ka maana hua (accepted) mechanism:

blocks.latex: \begin{aligned} &\text{Step 1: } \ce{NO2_{(g)} + F2 ->[Slow] NO2F_{(g)} + F^{\bullet}_{(g)}}\qquad \text{Rate} = k_1[\ce{NO2}][\ce{F2}] \\ &\text{Step 2: } \ce{NO2_{(g)} + F^{\bullet}_{(g)} ->[Fast] NO2F_{(g)}}\qquad \text{Rate} = k_2[\ce{NO2}][\ce{F^{\bullet}}] \end{aligned}
blocks.text_alt: Step 1: NO₂(g) + F₂ →(slow) NO₂F(g) + F•(g)   Rate = k₁[NO₂][F₂];  Step 2: NO₂(g) + F•(g) →(fast) NO₂F(g)   Rate = k₂[NO₂][F•]

blocks.text: Pehla qadam sust hai aur rate tai karta hai, jo dekhe gaye rate law se milta hai. Doosra tez qadam rate par asar nahi karta kyun ke fluorine atoms (F•) bante hi NO₂ se react kar jate hain.
Quick Check 7.9
Acid wala hydrogen peroxide solution iodide ions se react karta hai:
Is reaction ki rate equation:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein rate equation 'rate = [H₂O₂][I⁻]' chhapi hai, yani rate constant k reh gaya hai. Sahi: rate = k[H₂O₂][I⁻].
Is ke liye yeh mechanism tajweez kiya gaya hai:

blocks.latex: \begin{aligned} &\ce{H2O2 + I^- ->[Slow] H2O + IO^-} \\ &\ce{H^+ + IO^- ->[Fast] HIO} \\ &\ce{HIO + H^+ + I^- ->[Fast] I2 + H2O} \end{aligned}
blocks.text_alt: H₂O₂ + I⁻ →(slow) H₂O + IO⁻;  H⁺ + IO⁻ →(fast) HIO;  HIO + H⁺ + I⁻ →(fast) I₂ + H₂O

blocks.prompt: Wazahat karein ke yeh mechanism rate equation se kyun mel khata hai.
blocks.explanation: Pehla qadam sust hai, yani rate-determining step. Is mein ek H₂O₂ aur ek I⁻ hissa lete hain, is liye rate H₂O₂ aur I⁻ dono ke lihaz se first order hai: rate = k[H₂O₂][I⁻]. H⁺ aur doosra I⁻ sirf baad ke tez qadmon mein aate hain, is liye rate equation mein nahi. IO⁻ aur HIO intermediates hain; teeno qadam jama karein to kul equation milti hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Mechanism elementary qadmon ka silsila hai; molecularity = ek qadam ke molecules (uni-, bi-, termolecular); intermediates bante aur kharch hote hain, kul equation mein nahi aate.
Sab se sust qadam (rate-determining step) ke reactants rate law banate hain: 2NO + H₂ (sust) → rate = k[H₂][NO]²; NO₂ + F₂ (sust) → rate = k[NO₂][F₂].
